svg.aria-label: I build: End-to-end MERN apps, microservices and clean APIs, real-time WebSocket features, and databases tuned for speed. I care about: Security built in from day one: JWT, encryption, role-based access, and HIPAA-compliant handling of health data. I’ve worked in: Healthcare · Automotive · Enterprise · QHSE management · Aged care & NDIS · Hospitality
